title: Cientista De Dados
description:
A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes. Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade. O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos. Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos. Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas. Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados. Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados. Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final. Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção. Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados. Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL. Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models). Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas. Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar. SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE: Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics. Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.). Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção. Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Ciência de Dados ou IA. Benefícios Universidade em Rede TOTVS, uma universidade Corporativa com conteúdos e certificações gratuitos para cada pessoa colaboradora;
Programa +Saudáveis, que cuida de cada TOTVER com assessoria e ações voltadas para o bem estar em corpo, mente e finanças pessoais;
Programa +Vantagens, amaior rede de descontos da América Latina, exclusivos para nossas pessoas colaboradoras;
Programa + Cuidado, programa de apoio pessoal para pessoas colaboradoras e familiares, com orientações em diversas especialidades como: psicologia, serviço social, pet consultoria... Einstein Conecta, benefício de orientação médica online pelos médicos do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito;

Escritório queestimulaa criatividade e produtividade com ambientes para lanches, salas de jogos, mesas de bilhar e poltronas para relaxar;

description:

The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Desde 2001 fazemos parte de um dos maiores conglomerados de defesa mundial: o Grupo Elbit Systems. E isso nos torna únicos: temos uma essência local, com presença e tecnologia global.

title: Especialista Funcional Sap
description: Somos Atvos!Na Atvos, produzimos e comercializamos etanol, açúcar VHP e energia elétrica a partir da cana-de-açúcar e da biomassa. Nossa energia vai além do negócio: está nas pessoas e no nosso jeito de ser. Com capacidade para abastecer mais de 60 milhões de carros com etanol, adoçar milhões de festas com nosso açúcar e levar energia para o bem-estar de mais de 20 milhões de pessoas, também somos destaque na emissão de CBIOs. Atuamos com responsabilidade, desenvolvendo comunidades, cuidando do meio ambiente e transformando vidas. Aqui na Atvos lideramos a transição energética para mover o mundo e transformar vidas.Confira mais da nossa empresa pelo site: #VemPraAtvosAqui, diversidade é essencial! Nossas vagas são destinadas a todos, com incentivo á participação de mulheres e PCDs.Descrição da vaga:Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional SAP (PP/PM), com forte capacidade analítica, visão de processos e habilidade para atuar em ambientes complexos e integrados. Esse(a) profissional será responsável por conectar as áreas de negócio às soluções sistêmicas, garantindo a evolução contínua dos processos de produção e manutenção, com foco em eficiência, governança e aderência às melhores práticas.Responsabilidades e atribuições:Atuar no levantamento e tradução de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio, garantindo entendimento claro das necessidades.Desenhar soluções funcionais e elaborar especificações para implementação e melhorias no sistema.Conduzir testes integrados e apoiar usuários nas validações (UAT), assegurando qualidade das entregas.Atuar na resolução de incidentes e problemas (nível N3), com foco em análise de causa raiz e melhoria contínua.Garantir a integração entre módulos SAP (PP, PM, MM, FI) e sistemas externos.Apoiar processos de go-live, hypercare e evolução contínua dos sistemas e processos.Atuar na definição e validação de perfis de acesso (roles), garantindo aderência aos processos e compliance.Contribuir com melhorias contínuas nos processos de negócio, propondo soluções eficientes e escaláveis.Atuar em parceria com diferentes áreas, garantindo alinhamento entre tecnologia e operação.Requisitos e qualificações:Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.Experiência sólida com SAP PP e PM (ECC ou S/4HANA).Conhecimento em processos industriais, com foco em produção e manutenção.Vivência com integrações SAP e atuação em ambientes complexos.Experiência com sustentação e projetos.Capacidade analítica, organização e comunicação clara.Diferenciais:Experiência com múltiplos módulos SAP e ambientes altamente integrados.Vivência em projetos de implementação ou rollout SAP.Experiência em ambientes industriais ou de grande porte.Conhecimento em boas práticas de governança e compliance em sistemas.Informações adicionais:Nosso modelo de trabalho é híbrido, com três dias presenciais por semana em nosso escritório em Pinheiros/SP. Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e conectado com o propósito de produzir energia limpa e renovável, impulsionando o futuro sustentável do país.Benefícios que fortalecem nossa energiaNa Atvos, acreditamos que cuidar das pessoas é essencial para transformar o amanhã. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, desenvolvimento e qualidade de vida dentro e fora do campo ou do escritório.Confira o que você encontra por aqui:PLR anual, de acordo com seu desenvolvimentoAssistência médicaAssistência odontológicaVale RefeiçãoVale Transporte ou EstacionamentoAuxílio CrechePrevidência privadaTotalPass – para cuidar da sua saúde física e mentalSeguro de VidaPrograma Indicação de Talentos Atvos – indique profissionais que compartilhem nosso propósito e seja reconhecido por issoAqui, crescer com consistência significa unir inovação, sustentabilidade e propósito para gerar impacto positivo nas pessoas, nos negócios e no planeta.Se você acredita em um futuro movido por energia limpa e por gente que faz a diferença, vem transformar o amanhã com a gente.

description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. description:
Purpose of the Position The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years. Main Challenges and Assignments Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.Experience and Professional Qualifications Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial description: ARQUITETO CONSULTOR DE DADOS(Enterprise Architecture | Hybrid & Multi-Cloud)A Copel busca um Arquiteto Consultor de Dados de alto nível para liderar a modernização e a governança de um ecossistema complexo e distribuído. O desafio exige orquestrar uma arquitetura que integra o core no GCP com sistemas críticos em AWS, OCI (SAP S/4) e infraestruturas On-premises, garantindo uma transição fluida para modelos de Data Mesh/Data Fabric e Lakehouse, sempre sob os rigorosos padrões da Arquitetura Corporativa (TOGAF). Conhecimento e vivência na construção de Data Produtos. ESCOPO DE ATUAÇÃO E RESPONSABILIDADES:Design de Arquitetura Híbrida (On-premise & Cloud): Projetar e gerenciar a integração entre o legado físico e a nuvem, garantindo a integridade do dado.Governança e Modelos de Entrega: Implementar o paradigma de Data Mesh e modelos Hub-and-Spoke, provendo ambientes de Sandbox seguros e estruturas de consumo para produtos de dados.Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de saúde de infraestrutura e pipelines, garantindo visibilidade total sobre a operação.Modernização Real-Time (Stream): Implementar estratégias de ingestão em modalidade Stream e fluxos transacionais.Design de Soluções (As-Is e To-Be): Mapear o estado atual e projetar o roadmap futuro, documentando regras de negócio e pipelines.Gestão de Engenharia e Qualidade: Garantir a aplicação de modelos de Fato e Dimensão com rotinas de validação na infraestrutura.Gestão de Alta Performance: Atuar com foco em Metas e Resultados, realizando a gestão de prazos, recursos físicos e financeiros (FinOps).Definição de arquitetura de governança e virtualização de dados.Definição e implantação de ferramentas de aquisição, com construção completa de pipelines de ingestão de dados.Atuar como referência técnica, mentorando o time e disseminando conhecimento sobre as plataformas e tecnologias adotadas.Projetar e implementar soluções de dados ponta a ponta, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e segurança.Definir modelos de dados otimizados para custo e eficiência.Estabelecer modelo de orquestração e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes batch e streaming. PERFIL E REQUISITOS:Formação Acadêmica: Sólida formação em Engenharia de Software, Computação ou Ciência da Computação ou cursos correlatos com especialização em Dados.Idiomas: Habilidade avançada com a língua inglesa (leitura, escrita e conversação).Comunicação Interpessoal: Habilidade para influenciar stakeholders executivos e orientar times técnicos.Domínio de Ambientes Híbridos: Experiência comprovada na integração de ambientes On-premises com soluções Cloud.Frameworks e Metodologias: Conhecimento sólido em TOGAF e experiência com modelos Hub-and-Spoke/Sandbox.Especialista em Cloud (GCP): Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer e AlloyDB.Multi-Cloud e Bancos de Dados: Vivência com AWS, OCI e Bancos Oracle CDB/PDB, MongoDB e AlloyDB, CloudSQl, BigTable. DIFERENCIAIS:Certificações Cloud: Certificações oficiais Google Cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer).Tecnologias Emergentes: Experiência com Denodo e uso de IA para aceleração de desenvolvimento de atividades de engenharia de dados.Desejável experiência na ferramenta Denodo.Participação na estruturação de processos. title: Cientista De Dados
description:
A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes. Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade. Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados. Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados. Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final. Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção. Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados. Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL. Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models). Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas. Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar. SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE: Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics. Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.). Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção. Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Ciência de Dados ou IA. title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Uma das pioneiras em soluções de inteligência de dados no Open Finance, a klavi é uma das instituições que mais cresce nesse ecossistema, levando inovação através de dados a milhares de brasileiros. A klavi utiliza tecnologia própria e de ponta para viabilizar a coleta de dados, além de automatizar todo o processamento desses dados para transformá-los em valor de negócio.Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de QA com foco em garantir a qualidade, confiabilidade e desempenho das soluções desenvolvidas pela Klavi. O objetivo é assegurar que nossas entregas atendam aos mais altos padrões de qualidade, proporcionando uma excelente experiência para os usuários finais.Cultura da klavi Busca constante pela excelência: Somos automotivados, nunca satisfeitos e sempre buscando melhorias. Cada pessoa deve ser um especialista na empresa e em seu segmento. Nós elevamos continuamente o nível para fornecer produtos, serviços e processos de alta qualidade.Inovar para revolucionar: Encorajamos as pessoas a serem curiosas e a desafiarem o status quo. Ouvimos sempre novas ideias e estamos abertos a perguntas. Não temos medo de mudanças.Construção e valorização coletiva: Colabore com seus colegas e celebrem juntos as vitórias. Sejam transparentes, respeitosos e confiem uns nos outros. Nós não reclamamos, mas encontramos soluções juntos.Foco no sucesso do cliente: Nosso sucesso está enraizado no sucesso dos nossos clientes. Sempre nos esforçamos para superar suas expectativas. Buscamos fornecer as melhores soluções e valores a longo prazo.SalárioRegime: PJSalário: CompetitivoNível: EspecialistaPrincipais responsabilidades Investigar e diagnosticar falhas, identificando a causa raiz de bugs e inconsistências no sistema.Criar suítes de testes com base nos requisitos funcionais e não funcionais das features.Implementar testes automatizados para garantir a cobertura e a confiabilidade de novas funcionalidades.Validar o estado do sistema antes de implantações, garantindo que todos os ambientes estejam estáveis e prontos para release.Ter um entendimento profundo dos fluxos atuais do sistema para antecipar riscos e propor melhorias de qualidade.Monitorar continuamente a saúde e o desempenho das aplicações, atuando preventivamente em casos de instabilidade. title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:
About the ProductFor more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Role OverviewWe are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable ofbuilding architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migrationstrategy.Key Responsibilities- Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.- Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.- VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.- Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.- Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.- Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.- Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.- Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeterRequired Qualifications- Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.- Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.- Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.- Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.- Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.- Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.- English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have- PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.- Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.- Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.We offer- We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.- Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).- Personal laptop.- Health and wellness package.- Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Controlling Supervisor
description:
Role DescriptionThis is a full-time, on-site role for a Controlling Supervisor located in Sorocaba, SP. The Controlling Supervisor will oversee financial planning, cost management, and budgeting processes to ensure operational efficiency. They will analyze financial performance, create detailed financial reports, and provide insights to support decision-making. The role includes collaboration with cross-functional teams, ensuring compliance with company policies, and identifying areas for cost optimization and process improvement. Conduct financial planning (annual and monthly budget vs. actual), in accordance with the parent company's calendar and guidelines, consolidating information from various areas and preparing financial analyses and statements to support senior management in decision-making;
Perform CAPEX analyses (budgeted vs. actual), monitoring deviations and opportunities for optimization;
Ensure the planning andcontrol of working capital, through the projection of revenues, costs, expenses, payroll, accounts receivable and payable, inventories and taxes, identifying financial needs and opportunities;
Prepare monthly resultsbudget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;
Monitor the results of cyclical inventories, both internal and external, ensuring adequate financial impact;
Monitor and auditcompany materials held by suppliers, performing physical vs. system reconciliations and ensuring the accuracy of balances;
Perform monthly P&L closing, analyzing revenues, costs, operating expenses, freight, payroll, and extraordinary variations, in accordance with internal rules and procedures;
Update financial and operational databases (volumes, prices, average costs, risks, and opportunities), contributing to the predictability of monthly and annual results;
Prepare and report financial and management indicators to the plant and headquarters, through systems, reports, and executive presentations;
Prepare and update management presentations and strategic reports;
Attend to internal and external audits, providing information, analysis, and evidence;
Provide technicalsupport to area employees, guiding and clarifying doubts related to controllership processes;
Perform other related activities inherent to the position, as directed by the immediate supervisor.Assess the impacts of exchange rate variations, mapping exchange rate exposure based on imported items and performing scenario simulations;
- Prepare monthly results budget and Balance Sheet, with critical analysis and consolidation of systemic data and data from other areas, supporting preventive and improvement actions;

description:
About Turing:Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview:We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like:You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:- Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)- In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements:- Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)- Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills- Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.- Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.- Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.- Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.- Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.- Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications:- Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.- Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)- Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.- Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:- Work in a fully remote environment.- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.- Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:- Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)- Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgniteFirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The RoleWe're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do- Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.- Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes ("does this surface the right principal investigator?") into precise, measurable rubrics.- Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.- Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.- Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.- Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.- Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements- 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.- Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.- Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.- Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.- Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.- Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications- Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.- Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.- Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.- Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role- You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.- AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.- Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.- Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Cro Expert — Dtc Ecommerce
description:
About Turing:Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview:We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like:You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:- Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)- In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements:- Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)- Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skills- Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.- Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.- Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.- Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.- Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.- Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications:- Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.- Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)- Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.- Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:- Work in a fully remote environment.- Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.- Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:- Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)- Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_AngelesKnow amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

We’re building a best-in-class product with world-class talent to serve customers who rave about us. Will you join us? About you: This is a direct-hire role. Working with the Success team, diagnose root causes of underperformance (targeting, messaging, timing, setup) and implement corrective actions that directly improve campaign outcomes.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgniteFirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The RoleWe're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do- Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.- Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (/"does this surface the right principal investigator?/") into precise, measurable rubrics.- Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.- Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.- Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.- Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.- Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements- 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.- Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.- Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.- Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.- Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.- Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications- Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.- Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.- Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.- Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role- You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.- AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.- Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.- Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description: About FirstIgniteFirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack.We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The RoleWe're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse.This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do- Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents.- Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (/"does this surface the right principal investigator?/") into precise, measurable rubrics.- Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests.- Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch.- Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality.- Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion.- Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements- 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems.- Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling.- Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them.- Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked.- Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week.- Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications- Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents.- Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems.- Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain.- Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role- You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define.- AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue.- Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring.- Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.This is a fully remote position. We have engineers across the Americas, Europe, and Africa. Overlap with US working hours is expected.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de profissionais apaixonados por tecnologia para atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e estratégico na área de Projetos , contribuindo diretamente para a disponibilidade, segurança e performance da infraestrutura tecnológica da empresa.

Nesta posição, você será responsável por coordenar iniciativas estratégicas de TI e infraestrutura digital entre a área de TI Global da BYD (China) e as operações no Brasil. Garante a execução dos projetos, o alinhamento entre stakeholders, a conformidade com a governança e a comunicação entre equipes multilíngues. Liderará o planejamento, execução e entrega de programas de infraestrutura de TI, redes, datacenter e transformação digital alinhados aos padrões globais da BYD e aos objetivos operacionais regionais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Liderar atividades de gestão de projetos de TI de ponta a ponta, incluindo planejamento, cronograma, controle de riscos e governança de entrega alinhados aos padrões de BYD Global IT.
  • Atuar como principal elo bilíngue entre a sede da BYD na China e as equipes operacionais no Brasil, garantindo comunicação precisa em mandarim, português e, quando necessário, inglês.
  • Coordenar projetos de infraestrutura, redes, datacenter, cyber segurança e plataformas digitais entre equipes multifuncionais.
  • Desenvolver e manter roadmaps de projetos, marcos e planejamento de recursos alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos corporativos.
  • Gerenciar orçamentos de projetos, coordenação de aquisições e avaliação de desempenho de fornecedores.
  • Facilitar relatórios executivos e revisões de governança, fornecendo dashboards de progresso e insights para tomada de decisão da liderança sênior.
  • Garantir que os projetos estejam em conformidade com frameworks de governança de TI da BYD, padrões corporativos e requisitos regulatórios regionais.
  • Coordenar processos de gestão de mudanças para implantações de infraestrutura e transições operacionais.
  • Identificar riscos de projetos, dependências e estratégias de mitigação para garantir cumprimento de cronograma e qualidade.
  • Apoiar a integração entre iniciativas de infraestrutura de TI e operações industriais em ambientes de manufatura.
  • Colaborar com equipes de cyber segurança, redes, datacenter e suporte, garantindo alinhamento com prontidão operacional e continuidade de serviços.
  • Organizar e liderar reuniões de projetos interculturais, traduzindo discussões técnicas e estratégicas entre equipes de mandarim e português.
  • Manter repositórios de documentação de projetos, incluindo termos de abertura, registros de riscos, relatórios de governança e resumos executivos.
  • Promover melhoria contínua na governança de projetos, padrões de documentação e colaboração entre regiões.
  • Fornecer mentoria e orientação para coordenadores de projetos e analistas juniores dentro da estrutura do PMO.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Graduação em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Sistemas ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Conhecimento sólido em plataformas de virtualização (VMware, Hyper‑V) e gerenciamento de armazenamento;
  • Experiência em operações de backup, validação de recuperação de dados e monitoramento com Zabbix, PRTG ou Grafana;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos de DRP/BCP, métricas RTO/RPO e testes de recuperação de desastres;
  • Conhecimento de ambientes de servidores Windows e Linux, redes e gestão de capacidade;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks ISO 27001 e ITIL, garantindo alinhamento de documentação e conformidade;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de troubleshooting para incidentes de hardware e software;
  • Inglês avançado para documentação técnica e comunicação com fornecedores e stakeholders;
  • Capacidade de coordenar manutenção de fornecedores e validar entregáveis;
  • Alto nível de disciplina operacional, controle de configuração e rotinas de manutenção preventiva;
  • Conhecimento das normas de segurança NR aplicáveis a operações de datacenter e conformidade com EHS;
  • Disponibilidade para participar de testes de DRP/BCP e operações em turnos;
  • Certificação em VMware Certified Professional – VCP (Data Center Virtualization); Microsoft Server Administrator e/ou ITIL Foundation (Service Operations ou Service Transition);

Desejável:

  • Certificação em Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator (MCSA) ou Azure Administrator (AZ-104);
  • CompTIA Network+ ou Cloud+ (compreensão de redes de datacenter);
  • Veeam Certified Engineer (VMCE) ou Veritas NetBackup Administrator;
  • ISO/IEC 27001 Internal Auditor (desejável);
  • Certificação profissional de monitoramento Zabbix / PRTG;
  • Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) – opcional.
Informações adicionais

Aqui na BYD priorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores e estamos em busca constante de melhorias para o nosso pacote de benefícios. Seu pacote vai contar com:

  • Convênio médico e odontológico para você e seus dependentes;

description:
Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Principal Genesys Cloud Professional Services Consultant to join our team and drive the delivery of innovative, enterprise-grade contact center solutions.

In this role, you will lead the design and implementation of advanced multi-channel customer experience platforms, leveraging deep expertise in Genesys Cloud and modern contact center technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical leadership, hands‑on delivery experience, and the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high‑quality solutions.

Responsibilities
  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, providing expert consultancy on Genesys Cloud solutions.
  • Lead the design and delivery of end‑to‑end technical solutions, including facilitating workshops, gathering requirements, and producing technical design documentation with stakeholder sign‑off.
  • Analyze complex business and technical challenges to define scalable and effective solution architectures.
  • Own and evolve the technical architecture of Genesys solutions, introducing new technologies and best practices where appropriate.
  • Configure and optimize Genesys Cloud environments to align with changing business and operational needs.
  • Lead the planning and execution of contact center deployments, migrations, and system upgrades.
  • Act as the main escalation and coordination point for Genesys‑related matters, collaborating with internal teams and external vendors.
  • Support production readiness activities and ensure smooth transition of contact center solutions into live environments.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience supporting and optimizing large, multi‑site, complex contact center environments.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and supporting Genesys Cloud solutions in enterprise settings.
  • Proven expertise in building routing strategies and IVR workflows using Genesys Architect
  • Experience with CRM integration (e.g., Salesforce, MS Dynamics) with the Genesys Cloud environment
  • Strong background in infrastructure planning, solution design, deployment, and lifecycle management to ensure high availability and performance.
  • Solid understanding of business processes and their alignment with customer experience technologies.
  • Deep knowledge of SIP infrastructure, including SIP protocol, Session Border Controllers (SBC), and load balancing approaches.
Nice to Have
  • Knowledge of Genesys Cloud Workforce Management (WFM): provide expert guidance and best practices to optimize workforce management processes within the Genesys Cloud environment.
  • Genesys Cloud Training: conduct training sessions for various roles, including supervisors, administrators, users, and architects, to enhance their understanding and effective use of Genesys Cloud features
  • Experience with CX Cloud from Genesys and Salesforce
Additional Information

We offer:

  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

Quer ser um diretor escolar de excelência? Vem com a gente! ️

Assumir a direção de uma escola vai muito além de ocupar um cargo: é uma oportunidade única de impactar vidas e deixar um legado na educação. Aqui no Grupo Salta, oferecemos a chance de iniciar uma jornada que vai expandir ainda mais o seu potencial. Ao fazer parte do nosso time de diretores, você vai liderar uma das escolas do maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil, inspirando as vidas da sua comunidade escolar e deixando a sua marca no cenário educacional do nosso país.

Juntos, podemos construir um futuro em que a educação seja dinâmica, transformadora e fortalecida em uma cultura de excelência. Vamos transformar histórias: a sua, a nossa e a da educação de todo o Brasil.

O primeiro passo para a excelência começa aqui. Vem com a gente e faça parte desse legado! ✨

  • Gestão da equipe pedagógica e administrativa: Supervisionar e orientar as equipes pedagógicas e administrativas, promovendo o desenvolvimento profissional e garantindo o alinhamento com as metas institucionais;
  • Gestão do calendário escolar, projetos e eventos pedagógicos da escola: Garantir o cumprimento do calendário escolar, considerando excelência, qualidade técnica, comunicação e alinhamento à cultura da escola, de todos os projetos e eventos pedagógicos;
  • Atendimento aos responsáveis: Manter um canal de comunicação eficaz e acolhedor com os pais e responsáveis, garantindo o esclarecimento de dúvidas, resolução de problemas e a construção de uma relação de confiança com a comunidade escolar;
  • Desenvolvimento de equipe: Promover a formação contínua de professores e funcionários, garantindo alinhamento às metas da escola e atualização pedagógica constante, além de realizar avaliações periódicas do desempenho docente, com feedback e suporte para aprimoramento;
  • Captação e retenção de alunos: Atuar em estratégias de marketing educacional, elaborando planos de captação e fidelização de alunos, e promover uma experiência positiva para as famílias, consolidando a escola como referência de excelência na região;
  • Inovação e excelência: Incentivar a integração de tecnologia e práticas inovadoras no ensino, acompanhando tendências educacionais e implementando melhorias contínuas no currículo e na metodologia da escola.
  • Formação superior completa em Pedagogia, Educação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em gestão escolar, preferencialmente em instituições de grande porte;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, comunicação e tomada de decisão;
  • Cursar ou ter cursado pós-graduação em Gestão Escolar é um diferencial.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Fique tranquilo (a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos.

CONHEÇA O GRUPO SALTA EDUCAÇÃO

Somos o maior grupo de educação básica do Brasil e temos a missão de construir um país melhor para as próximas gerações. Quer saber como fazemos isso?

Acreditamos que o ensino de qualidade pode ser um modelo sustentável para impactar crianças e jovens em todo o país. E esse desafio nos move diariamente.

Para realizar esse sonho, contamos com um time inovador e criativo, cheio de energia e, principalmente, apaixonado pelo que faz. O nosso DNA é marcado pela cultura de excelência, impacto social, desenvolvimento pessoal e espírito realizador.

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e, por isso, visamos a contratar talentos em igualdade de oportunidades. Também levamos a inclusão a sério, pensando em processos de reconhecimento justos e éticos, além de contarmos com grupos de afinidade racial, LGBTQIA+, de pessoas com deficiência e de gênero.

Se você quer ser impulsionado para impulsionar, o Grupo Salta é o seu lugar. Venha construir um legado de transformação conosco!

VEM SER GENTE QUE FAZ BEM!

Na história da Pague Menos , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Promover o acesso à saúde significa ampliar liberdade, cuidado e qualidade de vida para milhões de brasileiros. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita por gente que faz bem e que está comprometida em levar saúde com amor pra todos os brasileiros. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país e, hoje, somos quase 1.700 lojas e mais de 28 mil colaboradores que formam uma comunidade diversa que cresce junto e trabalha com impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossa história começou em 1981, com a abertura da primeira loja em Fortaleza (CE). Desde então, seguimos crescendo com base na valorização das pessoas, no foco no cliente, na sustentabilidade, na integridade, na superação dos resultados e na inovação em soluções de saúde. Hoje somos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil , que é fruto de uma estratégia que combina eficiência, proximidade com o cliente e fortalecimento dos nossos consultórios farmacêuticos.

Nosso modelo de negócio une produtos, serviços e cuidado contínuo. Atuamos no varejo de especialidade com o conceito de drugstore e evoluímos para um hub integrado de saúde.

Trabalhar aqui é fazer parte de um ambiente que valoriza a diversidade, incentiva a autenticidade e acredita no poder da colaboração. É um lugar para crescer, contribuir e gerar impacto todos os dias. Bora juntos?

Ford abre vagas para 150 funcionários em Camaçari

14 de Julho de 2017 | 16h 57

Foto: Reprodução

Para aumentar a produção da fábrica, a montadora Ford, localizada no Polo Industrial de Camaçari, divulgou a abertura de cerca de 150 vagas para funcionários. “A Ford confirma que, durante o mês de julho, vai realizar cerca de 150 contratações para atender demanda de exportação”, disse a empresa em nota.

Para o diretor da montadora, Ricardo Menezes, com as novas contratações, a produção deverá aumentar de 900 para 1.100 carros por dia. A seleção será realizada pela empresa RH e Cia . A Ford, porém, não informou os detalhes dos cargos e da seleção. As informações são do Jornal Correio.

title: Product Manager (Senior/Lead) ID42374
description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
  • Experience in building subscription-based products with a track record of driving growth;
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
  • A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends;
  • Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.
